name: save-boot-17c-window1-walk-only
description: #224 diagnostic (attempt 1; removed before merge). As save-boot-17a but with no Circle press: hold Down 300 frames, then 34 frames with no input. w0..w3: raw states of the four windows. Window 1 not 0 here means the walk itself (a trigger), not a Circle talk, opens the message. Nothing waits after the load, so nothing can zero the results.
